title: Begin approved shop category replay repair
platforms: Linux interpreter and desktop test build; Windows/Wine pending
changes: Prepare an isolated desktop parser and dispatcher candidate for recorded shop category events 1024 through 1029, without changing or merging the main checkout runtime.
validation: Six targeted desktop replay tests and five serial shop-core tests passed on Linux. A separate harness compiled the actual candidate parser and dispatcher and matched the authenticated 529-frame USA recorded endpoint and clock; all six available slots and three invalid contexts were exercised. A new executable rejected an old recording identity as required. Protected inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: Candidate remains isolated and unintegrated. A pending shop semantic event was observed after replay and requires ownership validation. Fresh actual recording/verification, EUR, native/cache, input contention and Windows/Wine GUI checks remain. Initial ALSA metadata, harness literal and executable-size failures were resolved with retained diagnostics; no native Windows result.
